title: ExtlRecShrObject - Data API
description: Represents a shared object for Partner Connect. This object is available in API version 62.0 and later.

DefaultRecordOwnerId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
DefaultRecordOwnerId.description: ID of the shared record owner. The owner can be a user or a queue, represented by a Group ID. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

ExtlObjectType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
ExtlObjectType.description: Object type in the external org or system that is part of the object field mapping. Possible values are: ExtlRecShrLead ExtlRecShrOpportunity Lead Opportunity

ExtlRecShrCnctId.description: ID of the external record share connection. This field is a relationship field.

FieldMapStatus.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
FieldMapStatus.description: Exporter’s status of the field mapping. Possible values are: ActiveMapping Selected SystemOverride

InternalObjectType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort
InternalObjectType.description: Object type in your org or system used to group field selections and field mappings. Possible values are: ExtlRecShrLead ExtlRecShrOpportunity Lead Opportunity

special_access_rules: To see this object, enable Partner Connect or Partner Connect for Vendors. See Set Up Partner Connect as a Partner and Set Up Partner Connect as a Vendor in Salesforce Help.
